<reason>CON won by reframing as false choice and holding it: both sides end permanence, so the vote is on replacement. Singapore/Hong Kong prove rotation-reuse-columbaria works today, while PRO conceded no city runs composting/hydrolysis at scale and retreated to time-limited burial plus private transfer - CON's plan plus coercion dilemma. Religious-freedom and legality burdens were never discharged.</reason>
<best_rebuttal>A's second rebuttal plus pressure dilemma was decisive: enforce the mandate equals coercion against faith, accommodate equals keeping temporary burial and private eternity, collapsing PRO into CON's moderate alternative.</best_rebuttal>
